# signalJourney examples

These two files are copied unchanged from `schema/examples/` of the signalJourney release `signalJourney==0.2.0`, where they are part of the packaged schema.
`tests/images/test_sj.py` compares them byte for byte with the installed release, validates them with its schema, and shows that a record without `pipelineInfo` is rejected.
They are examples from the upstream project (BSD 3-Clause, the license of the `signalJourney` distribution), not NEMAR records.
